examples.text: Это шоссе экономит нам кучу времени.
examples.en: This highway saves us a lot of time.
There is a traffic jam on the highway.
This highway has lots of potholes.

examples.text: Вчера была страшная авария на шоссе.
examples.en: Yesterday, there was a terrible accident on the highway.
The highway runs parallel to the river.
